purpose: Estimate training-seed sensitivity without rerunning the complete five-model publication matrix.
decision_rule: Complete every job in the selected profile. Do not add or remove cells after inspecting new outcomes; failures may only be retried under the same frozen identity.

electra_full.evidence_scope: Full additional-seed matrix for ELECTRA. Together with seed 42, this supports five-seed ELECTRA summaries and seed-aware inference for the registered cells.

roberta_partial.evidence_scope: Three-seed directional sensitivity for H1-H4 on fold 1 only; not a complete RoBERTa-large multiseed matrix.

roberta_base_partial.evidence_scope: Three-seed directional sensitivity for H1-H4 on fold 1 only; not a complete RoBERTa-base multiseed matrix.

timelm_partial.evidence_scope: Three-seed directional sensitivity for H1-H4 on fold 1 only; not a complete TimeLM multiseed matrix.

bertweet_partial.evidence_scope: Three-seed directional sensitivity for H1-H4 on fold 1 only; not a complete BERTweet multiseed matrix.

reporting_limits: Only ELECTRA has a complete additional-seed matrix under this design.
The other four models cover fold 1 and four H1-H4-relevant systems only.
Do not report full-matrix cross-model seed uncertainty from partial profiles.
Do not use partial profiles for formal clean non-inferiority because the compute-matched clean-control system is outside their scope.
Report Colab hardware, source commit, completed/failed attempts, and observed worker time for every profile.
